description: This file defines a PHP class AddressFormat within the Opencart Admin Controller namespace. It handles CRUD operations and UI integration for address format configurations in the Opencart e-commerce platform, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting address formats via web requests.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: Controller class for managing address formats in the Opencart admin panel, encompassing listing, creation, editing, and deletion functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initial entry point to display the address formats list page with breadcrumbs, header, footer, and main view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles inline request to return the list of address formats, mainly used for AJAX refreshes.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the address formats list, including pagination and action URLs.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an address format, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes form submissions for creating or updating an address format, returning JSON success or error message.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected address formats, with permission and dependency checks, responding with JSON status.
